positions.name: SuiteEnrollmentRuleAndItsCarrier
positions.frame: What establishes the e2e suite's reviewer-enrollment rule as the governing account, and what role does this memory play relative to that rule?
positions.why: src-1 states the rule itself — the suite asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as reviewer, framed as a settled Decision. src-2 does not add a new claim; it subordinates this memory's entire purpose to carrying that assertion. Read together (as the relational pass's shared authority-ranking direction and the style pass's system-as-asserter / memory-as-carrier figures both flag across both segments), the pair coheres as one move: a rule is enacted by a named system-agent, and the artifact at hand exists only to transport that enactment. The tension worth naming: src-1 speaks with the suite's voice (an automated principal asserting), while src-2 speaks in the memory's own voice (an instrument describing its function) — two footings pointing at the same governing rule.
